title: Frame agreement for equal-length word patches
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a set, let $c_t:\mathbb{Z}\to\operatorname{Option}(\Gamma)$ be a tape, let $c_p\in\mathbb{Z}$, and let $u,v$ be finite words over $\Gamma$ of equal length. Suppose that for every integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le |u|$, the tape content at $c_p+p$ equals the content of the word $u$ at offset $p$. Then replacing the tape on the interval beginning at $c_p$ with $v$ gives, at every such offset $p$ from $-1$ through $|v|$, exactly the content of $v$ at offset $p$.
